verdict.rationale: White-labeling an authorization flow is a fair question for an MCP hosting and gateway platform like Manufact, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions custom branding of an OAuth or consent flow, or bringing your own OAuth app client ID and secret. The only auth items are Manufact's own MCP server authorization setup step and a community note about offline_access re-authentication; neither concerns white-labeling or customer-supplied credentials.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can white-label the authorization flow with my own branding and my own OAuth app credentials
